declarations.name: VALIDITY_KEYS
declarations.description: The validity keys in the order a field reports them: the first one that fails is the message shown.

Label, hint, error, warning and character counter around one form control. Put a single control in the default
slot: any form-associated `c2-*` control, or a native `<input>`, `<select>` or `<textarea>`. The field reads
`required`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `maxLength`, `value` and `validity` from the control, so state them once, on
the control.

A `c2-*` control receives the label and the hint or error as text through the field protocol
(`@c2n/core/contexts/field.js`) and puts them on its own focusable element, where the ids share one tree. While
a field wraps it, a control that draws its own hint line (`help`, `error-text`) hides it and the field draws it
instead. A native control is named by slotted light-DOM `label` and `hint` elements only.

Errors follow "reward early, punish late": nothing shows while the field is untouched or being typed in for the
first time. An error shows on submit (the control's `invalid` event), on `validate()`, or on blur or input when
`validate-on` asks for it, and from then on the field re-checks on every input, so the error clears as soon as the
value is fixed. The message is, in order: a server error set by `c2-form`, `error-text`, a slotted `error` element
whose `data-match` names the failing validity key, a slotted `error` element without `data-match`, the built-in
message for that key, and finally the control's own `validationMessage`.

Layout is CSS: `--c2-form-field--direction: row` puts the label beside the control (wrapping under it once the
control would be narrower than `--c2-form-field__body--min-width`), and custom properties inherit, so set them once
on a `c2-form` or any ancestor.

The host exposes custom states: `:state(invalid)` (the control fails a constraint), `:state(user-invalid)` (an
error is shown), `:state(warning)`, `:state(required)`, `:state(disabled)` and `:state(read-only)`.

cssProperties.description: `row` puts the label beside the control.
cssProperties.name: --c2-form-field--direction

cssProperties.description: Space between the label row, the control and the supporting line.
cssProperties.name: --c2-form-field--gap

cssProperties.description: Space between the label and the control in `row` direction.
cssProperties.name: --c2-form-field--column-gap

cssProperties.description: `1 / -1` spans every column of a `c2-form` grid.
cssProperties.name: --c2-form-field--grid-column

cssProperties.description: In `row` direction, the label moves above the control once the control would be narrower than this.
cssProperties.name: --c2-form-field__body--min-width

cssProperties.description: Aligns the label with the control's text in `row` direction (8px for a 36px control).
cssProperties.name: --c2-form-field__label--padding-top

cssProperties.description: Start padding of the supporting line, e.g. to line it up with a checkbox's text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-form-field__supporting-text--indent

cssProperties.description: The exclamation mark inside the icon.
cssProperties.name: --c2-form-field__icon-glyph--color

cssProperties.description: Counter colour once 10% or less of the limit is left.
cssProperties.name: --c2-form-field__counter__near-limit--color

cssParts.description: The row holding the label, the necessity marker and the label action.
cssParts.name: label-row

cssParts.description: The line under the control holding the hint, error or warning and the counter.
cssParts.name: supporting-text

slots.description: The control: one form-associated `c2-*` element or a native input, select or textarea.
slots.name: default

slots.description: A link or button at the end of the label row, e.g. "Forgot password?".
slots.name: label-action

slots.description: Rich hint content shown under the control; replaces `hint`.
slots.name: hint

slots.description: Error messages, read as text. Give one `data-match="valueMissing"` (or any other validity key) to show it only for that failure; one without `data-match` is used for any failure.
slots.name: error

members.name: hint
members.description: Plain-text hint shown under the control while there is no error or warning. The `hint` slot wins.

members.name: errorText
members.description: A custom error. Setting it makes the control invalid (`setCustomValidity`), so a form blocks submit until it is cleared.

members.name: warningText
members.description: A non-blocking warning, shown when there is no error. The form still submits.

members.name: counter
members.description: Shows `length / maxlength` under the control when the control has a `maxlength`.

members.name: necessity
members.description:
Marker style: `required` puts an asterisk on required fields, `optional` puts "Optional" on fields that are not
required, `none` shows neither. Unset, it follows the enclosing `c2-form`, then `required`.

members.name: validateOn
members.description:
When an error first shows: `submit` (default; the control's `invalid` event or `validate()`), `blur` (when focus
leaves an edited control) or `input` (on every edit). Unset, it follows the enclosing `c2-form`, then `submit`.

members.name: serverRendered
members.description: A declarative shadow root is attached before the element upgrades: the field was rendered on the server.

members.name: invalid
members.description: True while an error is shown.

members.name: errorMessage
members.description: The error text currently shown, or `''`.

members.name: validate
members.description: Runs validation now and shows the result. Returns true when the control is valid.

members.name: reset
members.description: Clears the shown error, the server error and the interaction state; called by `c2-form` on reset.

members.name: setServerError
members.description:
Shows an error from outside the control, typically a server response, and makes the control invalid until the
user edits it. An empty string clears it.

members.name: refresh
members.description: The control updates its validity in its own update cycle: wait for it before reading.

members.name: currentError
members.description: The error the control has now, shown or not; `''` when it is valid.

type.text: { length: number; max: number; near: boolean } | null

members.name: scheduleAnnouncement
members.description: Announce the remaining characters, politely and only near the limit, once typing pauses.

members.name: description
members.description: The description the control puts on its focusable element: the visible supporting line, prefixed.

members.name: linkNativeControl
members.description: A native control sits in the light DOM, so it can reference the slotted light-DOM label and hint directly.
